status: exploratory extension specified after the original benchmark outcomes were known and before any new selector outcome was computed

new_masks.no_stability: RASC aggregation with beta=1, retaining capped inverse-support weights and one reserved slot per supported class
new_masks.uniform_class_weights: RASC aggregation with rare_weight_cap=1, retaining bootstrap stability and class reservation
new_masks.no_reservation: Top 22 by the original RASC composite score with no reserved slots; stable feature-index tie breaking
new_masks.mutual_information: Each client computes continuous-feature kNN mutual information (3 neighbors); sample-count-weighted client scores determine the top 22; local constant columns have score zero; jitter seed is seed+2003*client_index
new_masks.random: 22 indices without replacement from RNG seed+1618033; no label-dependent selection

shared_controls: Original cohort, training-only transforms, partitions, initialization, RBM pretraining, class-balanced local sampling, 6 steps of 768 records per client per round, learning rates and earliest validation-maximum checkpoint rule were retained; no retuning or optional stopping
comparators: Reuse the corresponding 10 original 40-round RASC records for each optimizer; verify every rebuilt full RASC mask and partition digest against those records

analysis.unit: paired seed conditional on the fixed capture and split
analysis.direction: original RASC minus each new mask
analysis.test: two-sided exact sign flip across all 2^10 sign assignments
analysis.ci: 20000 paired-seed bootstrap means using RNG 97031; pointwise 95% intervals
analysis.multiplicity: Holm over all ten new contrasts, distinct from the unchanged original inference families
analysis.secondary: Accuracy, per-class recall, mask overlap and best validation round are descriptive
